unit.title: Test a call-back widget that connects web leads to sales

The source also observed increased other conversions, including direct phone numbers, says it can record calls like Response Tap, and gives pricing of $49/month on the annual plan or $59, including some phone numbers/calls.

unit.title: Use tawk.to for live chat

claim.text: The source recommends tawk.to as a free live chat tool that does everything expected; its business model sells agents to man the chat, but the software is free to use whether or not the business pays for agents. The source also notes admin area, team accounts, roundrobin availability, schedule opening/closing hours, offline message taking, and a mobile app.
claim.quote: This is talk to so t awk t awk. And it's free which is mental um because it's really good. It does everything that you would want a live chat software to do. It's a crazy business model they've got. Basically they make money by selling people to man the live chat. So, they give the software away free and they're hoping that you pay for their agents to man the live chat for you. Whether or not you do that, take advantage of the fact that this is an amazing tool and I can't believe that they're giving it away free. They could easily charge because it's as powerful as most of the paid tools. Um, really nice admin area. You can log in. You can give your team different accounts. Um, which means that when people are available, they can be put into the roundrobin to get the chats. You can schedule times as well. So, people are often worried. They think, you know, I don't want to be tied to my phone or tied to my computer at all hours of the day. unit.title: Add alert bars for sitewide calls to action
